prompt: Create a complete original 60-second instrumental cue in jazz-trio style. Use acoustic piano, brushed drums, double bass. Tempo 124 BPM. Immediate short melodic hook and steady rhythm from the first beat. Keep this groove present until the final bar. In the final second, all instruments play one resolved tonic chord and stop together, allowing a short clean natural tail. This must end musically, with no fade and no abrupt unfinished phrase. No slow intro, silent gap, long outro or atmospheric wash. Pure instrumental performance: instruments exclusively. No human voice, speech, singing, humming, choir, vocal samples or crowd sounds anywhere.

description.en: An upbeat and sophisticated jazz piece featuring a lively piano melody, walking bass, and light drums. It has a cheerful and elegant lounge feel.
description.zh: 一首欢快而精致的爵士乐曲，以活泼的钢琴旋律、行进贝斯和轻快的鼓点为特色。它带有一种愉悦优雅的休闲氛围。
